items.quote: they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die
items.claim: Viewing covered holy things results in death

items.quote: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things
items.claim: Proper procedural treatment prevents death when approaching holy things

items.quote: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden
items.claim: Aaron and his sons will assign individual Kohathites to specific service roles and burdens
